subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘FROST’ is written as ‘156’ and ‘CANDLE’ is written as ‘78’. How will ‘SCREAM’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (2) is multiplied by the sum of the position value of the letters within the word according to English alphabetic series

​So,

 
• ‘FROST’ is written as ‘156’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a16e24c2df8c6f3557a6604b70ba50edfbe2121e7ab8e79ac61ccc025c1f0f3.png] 

And,

 
• ‘CANDLE’ is written as ‘78’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b29908f37c161188e344015fe7ec004569655407a016e1336f15c59768fd4a93.png] 

Similarly,

 
• ‘SCREAM’ is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28c4c74a2d1902fa500f2dffe56a8339b32256e1cac08b13f49076e7f13a7f84.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "118".
